correctness.rationale: For the exact 4-uniform morphism φ(0)=0112, φ(1)=1230, φ(2)=2301, φ(3)=3023 with coding 0,2↦0 and 1,3↦1, the set of all adjacent state-letter pairs is T={01,02,03,11,12,13,21,22,23,30}: all occur in φ⁴(0), and checking factors of φ(xy) for xy∈T proves closure under further substitution. Every binary factor of length ≤18 occurs within or across one boundary of 64-symbol φ³-coded blocks, so it is present in one of the ten coded 128-symbol φ³(xy) words, and conversely every word appears in the true fixed point. Direct exhaustive enumeration of that globally justified finite cover yields P(1..18)=(2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,2,3,0,3,0,2,0,2,0,0), total 28 palindromes and exactly two length-16 examples. Absence of length-11 odd and length-18 even central palindromes forbids every longer odd/even palindrome, so finite coverage proves the infinite classification. All 28 first occur by prefix length 196, with the last length-16 occurrence beginning at index 180; the length-195 prefix has 27, establishing Def(u[0,N))=N−28 for N≥196 with sharp onset. Independently reconstructed φ iterates, exact T-closure, the 10×128 cover, palindrome sets, and sharp first occurrence; this check relies on proof of global factor coverage rather than treating a finite prefix as exhaustive.
